experiment: SmallVec scratch buffer for ASCII regex input conversion
mechanism: Use a per-call SmallVec<[u8; 128]> for the compiled ASCII matcher path in find_from_utf16 and find_range_from_utf16, avoiding the per-call heap allocation for short ASCII input while retaining UTF-16 as the authoritative string representation and using SmallVec spill storage for longer input.

micro_gate.interpretation: Instruction retirement fell consistently, but cycle intervals include zero and direction disagrees between exec and replace. The unaffected local-store control also moved by a similar cycle amount. No V8-v7 fixture gate was run because cycle evidence does not establish a reliable runtime benefit.
